quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: Stealthy Trail
quest.description: Ryuuji seems to have gotten some new leads and needs to investigate further...

talks.objective: Go to Bantan Sango Detective Agency

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: You're here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Found any leads?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Yes, thanks to Sango.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: We have largely confirmed a few locations with the aid of her deductions.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: At the moment, it appears that one of the camps is guarded by our "Hat Dog." This location requires greater care.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That was a very Paimonial nickname...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey now! Paimon wouldn't come up with such lame nicknames! If it were up to Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This dog would be called "Blade Pup!"

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I have placed similar devices around that location. Hopefully, they'll have the same effect as before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't ignore Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I'll leave the rest in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Any other questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can we count on this intel?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Most certainly. I did scout the areas out myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why aren't you coming with us this time, Ryuuji?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: I would have, if not for a certain other task that I must perform for Sango.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Broadly, she has some ideas as to the source of our "Hat Dog," and has asked that I investigate the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's "Blade Pup"!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: "Hat Dog."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: That combination doesn't work.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What sort of nickname is that, anyway!?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Hmm. Perhaps we should just return to calling it "Black Shadow."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Whatever the case, I leave the animals to you.

talks.objective: Go to the investigation site and perform the rescue
Go to the investigation site and perform the rescue

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Thank you very much. Hmm... These still aren't all of them...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That many animals went missing, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Unfortunately so, yes. Comparing these to the commissions we received, we should have found around half the missing animals.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, we're out of leads again. Fortunately, live animals are far easier to investigate than inanimate objects, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: We did receive just such a request from an important family recently.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Our trail ran cold, and if not for Sango's deductions, we would have lost it altogether.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup yup yup! This sounds super interesting — c'mon, let's hear some more!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I didn't know that you were so interested in our work.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: In truth, we had already locked onto our suspect. The trouble was that we could not find any incriminating evidence at his place, nor could we find any other clues.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Later, I heard, entirely by chance, that our suspect had sold some Naku Weed the day before. I went to the buyer to inspect the product and discovered it was indeed still fresh.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: After hearing this, Sango bade me go to the foothills of Mt. Yougou to investigate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? Why Mt. Yougou?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: "Our suspect lives on Narukami Island. Although Naku Weed can be found all over Inazuma, most people need a boat to get to the other islands, and we found no boat."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: "Additionally, the Tenryou Commission is very touchy about the use of boats due to the Sakoku Decree. If our suspect was planning to commit a crime, they would not have done it such that they would be exposed to the Commission."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: "That thus eliminates the other islands." That was what she said.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But there's Naku Weed around the Grand Narukami Shrine, isn't there? Why did you only check the foothills of Mt. Yougou?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sango considered this too. "Naku Weed grows around the Grand Narukami Shrine, yes, but the shrine maidens are there, and many worshippers frequent the area."

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: "If anything out of the ordinary were to happen there, it would be liable to be found out."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so that's how it is! Paimon can see why Sango's the brains of the party now!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: As it turned out, we did find a pile of soil in the foothills that showed signs of having been loosened recently. Our suspect had buried the stolen objects there and had been intending to wait out the heat before emerging and fencing these goods.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: But he thought that he might attract suspicion by leaving heavy-laden and returning empty-handed, so he collected Naku Weed along the way and made to sell them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah, but it was also the Naku Weed that got him caught!

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Indeed. As such, I believe that there are leads nearby. We just haven't thought to uncover them yet.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I believe that our present cooperation is quite ideal. After all, my true specialty is running errands, not stealth or combat. Leaving this part to you, in fact, suits me more than just fine.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: What do you think? Do you have any interest in working at Bantan Sango?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sango might seem a little... complicated to speak to, and she says strange things like "conscience holds wisdom back," but she is a gentle person at heart.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Ah. That's a shame.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Well, now that I think about it, this is for the best. If Sango had someone like you, I'd be out of a job.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I will continue my investigations. If you have other things you need to work on, please do them first.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: We will meet again, when the time comes, at the agency. Thanks once again for your efforts.

choices.text: Let's hope it goes well this time, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup! The people who lost their pets must be in a real panic right now...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, I leave the animals to you.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: Ryuuji's informed you of the exact locations, has he? Go, then. This time, the two of you should split up.

dialogues.speaker: Sango
dialogues.text: I've got an... interesting hunch about Black Shadow's origins that I'd like him to check out.
